title: The Salon
subtitle: When a Performance Cycle finalizes, extra Signatures are imprinted and placed here on open offer. The leading offer when a lot closes receives the piece, and the proceeds strengthen the next cycle’s allocation.
terms: Each cycle places {lots} Signatures in the salon. Offers open {openingDelay} after finalization. The first offer on a piece starts a {offerWindow} window; each offer must raise the leading one by at least {raise}, and an offer near the close extends it to leave at least {extension}.

connect.title: Connect a wallet to place offers
connect.description: The lots and their clocks are public. Placing an offer, concluding a lot, or retrieving a piece needs a connected wallet.

credit.notice: Offers of yours that were outdone are held for you:

absent.title: The salon has not opened on this network
absent.description: This network’s contracts do not include the salon yet. It opens with the V4 release.

empty.title: No Signatures on offer yet
empty.description: The next cycle’s finalization places the first pieces in the salon.

readFailed.title: The salon could not be read
readFailed.message: Reading the lots from the chain failed. Refresh to try again.

exhibit.title: Cycle {cycle} exhibit
exhibit.description: Signatures imprinted at this cycle’s finalization, each on offer separately.

lot.connectToOffer: Connect a wallet to place an offer.
lot.invalidAmount: Enter the offer as an ETH amount, like 0.25.
lot.offerTooLow: An offer must reach at least {minimum}.
